title: Name That Compound!: Naming & Formulas — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)

chapters.CHEM 3A: Chapter 4 (Skill Check #5: Naming Ionic Compounds and Covalent Molecules)

description: Naming and formula practice for CHEM 1A Chapter 2.7 (default) and CHEM 3A Chapter 4 (add ?course=3A), matched to CHEM 3A Skill Check #5. Students pick from 4 main options, Formula → Name, Name → Formula, Ionic or Covalent?, and Acids, then turn topics on or off: Type I ionic, Type II ionic with Roman numerals, polyatomic ions (Green Sheet, including -ate/-ite, per-/hypo-, hydrogen/dihydrogen and thio- rules), binary covalent molecules (mono- through deca-, no mono- on the first element, monoxide/tetroxide vowel dropping), hydrates (CHEM 1A), build it with jigsaw charge pieces, a Type I / Type II / covalent sorter, hydro-…-ic acids, oxyacids (-ate → -ic, -ite → -ous) and which-acid / which-ion questions. Formulas use smart typing (Ca3(PO4)2 becomes Ca₃(PO₄)₂; * or . makes the hydrate dot). Step-by-step help on every question: find the charges, criss-cross and reduce, check the charges sum to zero, or find the anion's charge and back-calculate the metal's Roman numeral. Mistake catchers with feedback: Roman numeral on a fixed-charge metal, missing Roman numeral, prefixes on ionic names, missing covalent prefixes, mono- on the first element, unreduced formulas, missing parentheses, -ite/-ate swaps, acid suffix and hydro- mistakes, unbalanced charges. Also a Free Builder with a compound log, a clickable periodic table, a rules sheet, Skill Check Prep (10 questions, then a study plan), XP, ranks, 10 achievements and ItsDrDan videos.
